question: Can a man likewise use that ash to make a woman his maidservant without doubt?
premises: The same ash application is implied from the previous verse.
A man may apply it toward a woman.
The text asserts the absence of doubt.
inference: A man can likewise make a woman his maidservant by this means, without doubt.
plain_english: Likewise, a man can make a woman his maidservant by this means; there is no doubt.
